description: Search aftermarket tyre products by tyre size specification. Required: section_width (mm), aspect_ratio (%), rim_diameter (inches). Optional: limit, offset. Returns tyre product listings matching the given size.

aspect_ratio.description: Tyre aspect ratio as a percentage integer 1-100 (e.g. 45). Required.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

rim_diameter.description: Rim diameter in inches (e.g. 18). Required. Must be positive.

section_width.description: Tyre section width in mm (e.g. 245). Required. Must be positive.

name: search-classified-tires
